snippet.title: SPACERO: ORIGINS — Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore an open galaxy, mine rare resources, battle hostile ships, upgrade your weapons, and build your way from a small starter ship into a true force among the stars.

The SPACERO: ORIGINS Demo gives players their first look at the game’s core loop: space exploration, ship combat, resource collection, faction encounters, stations, upgrades, and progression across a dangerous living galaxy.

Wishlist SPACERO: ORIGINS on Steam and play the demo.
